description: Practical steps for Indian creators to package, price, and sell exam-prep PDFs (SSC, bank, NEET, UPSC) with UPI checkout and automatic delivery.
primaryKeyword: sell exam prep PDFs in India
imageAlt: Exam preparation PDFs, revision sheets and mock tests for Indian students

blocks.text: Students already buy notes and mock tests. The problem for most sellers is delivery and payment: WhatsApp Drive links, personal UPI screenshots, missing order records, and refund fights when a link expires. A clean product page with an INR price, UPI checkout, and automatic download solves the operational mess.
This guide shows Indian creators how to package, price, and sell exam-prep PDFs for SSC, bank exams, NEET, UPSC, and state boards without relying on screenshots.
What exam prep PDFs actually sell
What exam prep PDFs actually sell

Start narrow. One exam family and one subject converts better than a vague “complete UPSC notes” megafile. Students pay when the title clearly names the exam, chapter, and year. Broad “all exams” packs look like scraped dumps and attract refunds.

Write titles the way people search: “SSC CGL Quant Chapter 4 PDF 2026”, not “Master Notes Vol 2”. Show page count and whether solutions are included on the product card so support messages stay short.

If you are selling chapter notes rather than full exam bundles, see our guide to [selling notes online](/guides/how-to-sell-notes-online-in-india-2026). Teachers can also explore [digital product ideas for educators](/guides/digital-products-for-teachers-to-sell-in-india), and our [digital products guide](/resources/digital-products) includes a practical first-offer checklist.
Why personal UPI + Drive links fail

items: Dozens of screenshots in a Telegram group and you still lose track of who paid
Files get forwarded to the next batch with no receipt
Refund requests start when the Drive link expires or permissions change
New students mid-cycle cannot buy and download without waiting for your reply

blocks.text: A proper product page creates an order record. Buyer pays with GPay or PhonePe, the file delivers automatically, and you keep a clean history. Gateway fees still apply; platform fees depend on the store you use.

UPI is an instant payment system developed by NPCI; read its [UPI overview](https://www.npci.org.in/product/upi). Check current terms on [Razorpay pricing](https://razorpay.com/pricing/) before estimating payment-processing costs, and use our [GST registration guide](/resources/do-you-need-gst-registration-to-sell-online) as a starting point for questions to take to a tax professional.
Weekend launch for one exam pack

items: Saturday morning: export one clean PDF. Add a cover page with exam name, chapter, and your store brand.
Saturday afternoon: create the product, set an INR price, connect bank details or payment keys.
Saturday evening: run one real UPI test purchase on mobile data and open the download yourself.
Sunday: put the product URL in Instagram bio, YouTube description, and one Telegram pinned message.
Next week: answer syllabus questions in chat. Keep every payment on the store link only.

blocks.text: Do not attach the paid PDF in the chat after the store is live.
Once your first exam pack is ready, run a test checkout before sharing its link with students.

blocks.text: Where exam traffic already is

items: YouTube: chapter walkthroughs with the pack link in the description and a pinned comment
Instagram Reels: one tip taken from the PDF, spoken price, and bio link
Telegram / WhatsApp: use for trust and doubt-clearing only; never send the paid file
Marketplace or discovery sections (if available on your platform) after the first paid sale

blocks.text: Pricing that feels fair to aspirants

Impulse sheets stay under ₹149. Full chapter packs with solutions often clear at ₹199–₹399. Full subject booklets can go higher when the preview proves depth. Underpricing a serious mock set trains buyers to expect free material forever. Overpricing a thin 8-page dump creates refund noise.
Practical rules:

items: Show a preview page count and one sample page
State clearly whether answers are included
Keep one launch price for at least seven days; do not renegotiate in DMs
Add a second pack only after the first has real completed sales

blocks.text: For a repeatable way to set and test a fair price, use our [digital product pricing guide](/resources/how-to-price-digital-products).
Quality bar so students do not feel scammed

items: Readable scans or properly typed text; fonts that work in phone dark mode
Correct syllabus year; outdated papers destroy trust quickly
No copied publisher PDFs you do not have rights to sell
Your name or brand on the cover so leaked files still point back to you

blocks.text: Some sharing will happen. Update packs each cycle. Optional PDF stamping or email delivery logs help with tracing, not prevention.
When a paid plan becomes useful

items: You need Quant and Reasoning packs live at the same time
You hit a free-tier sales or product limit during exam season
You want email capture for “next mock drops Saturday” announcements
You need better PDF tools or branding controls

blocks.text: Start free, prove the offer, then upgrade only when the limit actually blocks growth.

FAQ: Selling exam prep PDFs
Can I sell handwritten notes?
Yes, if every page is readable on a phone. Typed packs often feel more polished, but clear handwriting with a strong chapter title still converts for coaching audiences.
Do I need GST on day one?

GST registration depends on aggregate turnover, the kind and place of supply, and applicable exceptions; there is no single day-one answer for every seller. Read our [GST registration guide](/resources/do-you-need-gst-registration-to-sell-online) and confirm your circumstances with a qualified tax professional.
Should I sell only inside Telegram groups?
Use groups for trust and doubt clearing. Keep checkout on your store link so delivery and refunds stay clean. Telegram-only file dumps do not scale past your reply speed.
Can international students buy?
Most exam packs stay INR-only for India aspirants. International pricing can be added later if needed and if your payment setup supports it.
What if someone forwards my PDF?
Expect some leakage. Compete on updates, clarity, and next-cycle packs. Stamping helps trace sharing; it does not stop it.
Bottom line

Exam money should not live in screenshot archaeology. One honest pack, a clear rupee price, UPI checkout, automatic delivery, and one link everywhere students already watch you. Publish the first pack this weekend and improve from real sales data.
